messages.author: d9600013044609cf
messages.subject: RMR Broken pipe: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
parts:
I am using rmr2(2.3.0) with CDH v4 and getting Broken Pipe error after mapper is done processing the data. I gone through the related posts and tried a couple things.
 
When there is a reducer configured, the job is successful. Also the entire job with reducer is successful, when there mapper returns a single keyval. So I guess I must be doing something wrong in constructing the keyval or it is really a memory issue. Any help is greatly appreciated.
 
I attached the mapper code snippet, GC log, keyval returned by mapper, error log. There are 5 mappers and 1 reducer tasks configured.  The io.sort.mb setting is 237
 
I am very new to R. Any suggestions to improve the efficiency of the below code are welcome.
 
Code snippet (:
   for(rc in 1:2) {
        row.keyval <- handleRow(v[rc]);
        if(rc == 1) {
          row.key <- row.keyval[1]
          row.value.list <- rbind(row.keyval[[2]])
        } else {
          row.value.list <- rbind(row.value.list, row.keyval[[2]])
        }
    }
    kv <- keyval(row.key, row.value.list);
    rmr.str(kv)
    rmr.str(gc())
    return (kv)
 
handleRow function constructs the return value like this:
    kv <- list(2)
    kv[1] <- row.key;
    kv[[2]] <- data.frame(id = cell.id, value = krige.prediction, wkt = input[3], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    return (kv)

messages.subject: Re: RMR Broken pipe: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
parts: It looks like the error message is misleading. I tested it with three different input sizes: 792 rows, 250 rows, 100 rows. The number of Map tasks are 2, 1, 1 respectively. The map task for the last two cases failed with OutOfMemoryError. In case of 792 rows, there are two concurrent Map tasks. The first task is successful and second task is failing with the OutOfMemoryError. If it is memory issue, why the first Map task, which processed around 390 rows, is successful?

Unfortunately I have to live with that version for few more months. We are still using MR1. There are plans to upgrade it to YARN and CDH5+ later this year.
 
As I mentioned in my previous post, I tested with three different test sets. When there are multiple mapper tasks, the first one is successful. If there is a single mapper task, it is always failing. This is happening consistently. 
I will test this with more mapper tasks (>2) and report the status here.
 
Thanks for your help.
